name: Clean Hotbar — Flat Minimal HUD
summary: Replaces the busy vanilla hotbar with a flat, clean design and a clearer XP bar.
body:
The vanilla hotbar is thick and over-detailed. This pack uses a **flat, minimal design** with a clearer XP bar.

- 🎨 **Flat clean design** — less visual noise, same 9 slots
- 📊 **Clearer XP bar** — bright green, easy to read at a glance
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
> 💡 **CurseForge is the source of truth** — the most up-to-date, bug-free versions land there first: [Fliflight on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/fliflightmc/projects)

version.changelog: Initial release: flat clean hotbar + XP bar.
